basic_info.description: Great Inner Richmond location. One block to Golden Gate Park and Muni bus with easy access to Golden Gate Bridge. Close to both USF and UCSF. This offering is a 3BR-2BA unit in a 10 unit TIC Building. Completely remodeled kitchen which opens to the living room and dining area. Two full bathrooms also completely remodeled. Hardwood floors throughout, in unit laundry, and extra storage. North and West facing windows. Extra Storage locker in basement. Common utilities include steam heat, water, sewer and garbage and are billed at $492.40 per month.
